title: Larkfield County EMS and Healthcare Coalition: charter bus crash
summary: A fictional Wisconsin county EMS agency, fire department and hospital coalition (one Level II trauma center, a capacity board, START with a move to SALT), with an exercise generated from their simulated plans: a wet-evening crash between a senior charter bus and a fuel tanker with 28 patients, a command transfer, a firefighter in distress and a hospital already near capacity.
notice: EXERCISE MATERIAL — for training use. Larkfield County, its EMS, fire department, hospitals, people, businesses and sites are simulated; all patients are synthetic; the public sources consulted for realism are listed in reference/county-ems-mci/SOURCES.md.

scenarios.title: Open on Paper
scenarios.summary: On a rainy Tuesday evening a senior center charter bus and a fuel tanker collide on Highway 21; 28 patients, trapped passengers and a fuel leak overwhelm the first units, command passes from an engine captain to the battalion chief, a firefighter calls a mayday, and the Medical Group must match patients to hospitals while one hospital is on diversion.
